m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: The historical I/J source receipt only attested bytes and marks phase_b_replayed=false, and cannot by itself be called certified gameplay. The owner-approved M7 Rev1 100 changes exactly six cards versus Oct14; the first #713 review only ran five structural/decision tests. A new evidence-only PR #715, merged squash 88fee83d85072744b9a90da12192ad777f85e897, executed all five source-defined P0 cases C1/K1/K2/K3/F1 with full exact-100 candidate SHA, ten relevant fresh Oracle card records and source-payable positive/adversarial finite fixtures. The eleven P1 source cases remain explicitly deferred with individual scope consequences; no historical generator rerun, global I/J seal or multiplayer win probability is manufactured. Canonical Mairsil list and its owner approval were NOT altered.

P0.payable_fixture: Mairsil enters: cage owner's Asmodeus creature from hand and Displacer Kitten creature from graveyard, moving actual objects to owner's exile.
P0.positive_assertion: Both source objects leave originating zones, gain cage counters, and are available to Mairsil as owned exiled abilities.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Rhystic Study enchantment in hand and opponent-owned Pack Rat/grave cannot be selected as valid Mairsil cage sources.

P0.payable_fixture: Mairsil owns caged Asmodeus; one acquired draw-seven use, then legal Essence Flux or Kitten noncreature spell blink produces a distinct object ID.
P0.positive_assertion: The new Mairsil object can use the same caged ability once on its own activation set and the owned exile remains caged.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Second use on same Mairsil object is rejected; missing legal blink/precondition does not reset once-per-turn accounting.

P0.payable_fixture: Mairsil with caged Asmodeus pays {B}{B}{B}, reads nine-card library and performs seven draw effects.
P0.positive_assertion: Exactly seven cards move library-to-hand and two remain; Asmodeus static exile-draw replacement is not inherited from a caged activated ability.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Missing triple black prevents source payment; no extra same-object use and no erroneous replacement to exile for Mairsil.

P0.payable_fixture: Caged Pack Rat activation pays {2}{B}, discards one actual hand card, then Rings optional {2} copies activated ability without a second discard.
P0.positive_assertion: Original and paid Rings copied activation make two token-copy entries and corresponding entering-source triggers; legend rule allows at most one legendary Mairsil persist.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Without source mana/discard ability cannot activate; same-object second use blocked; copied ability does not create permanent unrestricted multiple legendary Mairsils.

P0.payable_fixture: Mairsil owned Asmodeus card in exile with cage; remove Mairsil from battlefield, then separately cast a fresh Mairsil object.
P0.positive_assertion: Owned exiled caged card stays in exile; fresh Mairsil can again access its activated ability.
P0.adversarial_assertion: While Mairsil is absent the player cannot activate its inherited draw ability despite caged card remaining in exile.
